mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM ${msg_table} WHERE TRAN_STATUS = '1' AND TRAN_TYPE = '5' AND TRAN_SENDDATE IS NULL AND TRAN_DATE <= SYSDATE AND TRAN_ETC3 IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE ${msg_table} SET TRAN_ETC3 = '${group_no}' WHERE TRAN_STATUS = '1' AND TRAN_TYPE = '5' AND TRAN_SENDDATE IS NULL AND TRAN_DATE <= SYSDATE AND TRAN_ETC3 IS NULL AND ROWNUM <= 500
mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(TRAN_PR) AS TRAN_PR, 'AT' AS TRAN_TYPE, TRAN_MSG AS TRAN_MSG, TRAN_MSG AS TRAN_MSG, CASE WHEN TRAN_PHONE LIKE '82%' THEN TRAN_PHONE WHEN TRAN_PHONE LIKE '010%' THEN '82' || SUBSTR(TRAN_PHONE, 2) ELSE '82' || SUBSTR(TRAN_PHONE, 2) END AS TRAN_PHONE, TRAN_CALLBACK AS TRAN_CALLBACK, TRAN_SUBJECT AS TRAN_SUBJECT, CASE WHEN LENGTHB(TRAN_MSG) <= 90 THEN 'S' ELSE 'L' END AS SMSKIND, TO_CHAR(TRAN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS TRAN_DATE, '2' AS p_invoice, TRAN_TMPL_CD AS TRAN_TMPL_CD, '${profile_key}' AS PROFILE_KEY, NVL(TO_CHAR(TRAN_SENDDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), '00000000000000') AS TRAN_SENDDATE FROM ${msg_table} WHERE TRAN_ETC3 = '${group_no}' AND TRAN_TYPE = '5' AND TRAN_STATUS = '1'
mapper.update: UPDATE ${msg_table} SET TRAN_STATUS = '2', TRAN_SENDDATE = SYSDATE WHERE TRAN_ETC3 = '${group_no}' AND TRAN_TYPE = '5'
UPDATE ${msg_table} SET TRAN_STATUS = '1', TRAN_SENDDATE = NULL, TRAN_ETC3 = NULL WHERE TRAN_ETC3 = '${group_no}' AND TRAN_TYPE = '5'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${log_table} SELECT * FROM ${msg_table} WHERE TRAN_PR = ${msgid}
